external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: WITH - Brød&Kaffe Google profile: rating 4.3/5, 265 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Very, very good coffee, unlike in a lot of Norwegian coffee shops. 🫣😁 Good sandwiches, nice atmosphere, lots of seating.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Great coffee, lactose-free milk available and amazing pastry 👌

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Yes the foods are on a small side and a bit expensive but you cant say anything bad about how their food tasting. If you want something soulles and not expensive then i think you should try go any chain coffee restorants.

Eat the club sandwich and the bread on that was very soft it literally melts you away and crispy bacon is just takes it even higher.

I recommend their mocca drink with 2 shots of espresso. That was quite banging!

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Came back after 6 years. Got a tiny coffee in a paper cup even though I was eating inside. The coffee tasted weird. The service was poor and the tables were full of trash. Had to reduce the rating from 5 stars to 2. 😞

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span:
Very nice cafe, it has a very cozy and dimm interior which is perfect for drinking coffee or eating a cake. Appart from the normal seats there are also a few separate and private rooms, one of which has toys and other stuff for children to play with

Will definitely come back if I'm in Tønsberg once again :)
